item.title: Heidi
item.description: Heidi is the heartwarming tale of a spirited young girl sent to live with her gruff grandfather in the Swiss Alps. Her infectious joy transforms not only her grandfather’s lonely life but also the hearts of everyone she meets. When she’s uprooted to the city, Heidi’s longing for the mountains and her unwavering kindness touch lives across class and distance. A story of resilience, simplicity, and the healing power of nature and love.
